title: Jeanne Dielman, 23 quai du Commerce, 1080 Bruxelles
plotSummary: Over three days, the film follows Jeanne Dielman, a widowed mother in Brussels, as she cooks, cleans, shops and looks after her teenage son, filmed in long, unbroken takes. She also sees a male client each afternoon to make ends meet, and as her rigid routine starts to slip, it ends in an act of violence.

title: Vertigo
plotSummary: San Francisco detective Scottie Ferguson retires after his fear of heights causes a colleague's death. An old friend hires him to follow his wife Madeleine, who seems possessed by a dead ancestor, and Scottie falls in love with her, then becomes obsessed with remaking another woman in her image.

title: Citizen Kane
plotSummary: When newspaper magnate Charles Foster Kane dies whispering "Rosebud", a reporter sets out to discover what the word meant. Interviews with his friends and associates trace Kane's life from his childhood to his building of a media empire, a failed run for office and a lonely old age in his vast Florida estate, Xanadu.

title: Tokyo Story
plotSummary: An elderly couple travel from their seaside town to Tokyo to visit their grown children, who are too busy with their own lives to spend time with them. Only Noriko, their widowed daughter-in-law, treats them with real kindness, and soon after they return home the mother falls ill.

title: 2001: A Space Odyssey
plotSummary: A mysterious black monolith appears to prehistoric apes and sparks their first use of tools. Millions of years later, another is found buried on the Moon, and astronauts Dave Bowman and Frank Poole head for Jupiter on a mission controlled by the computer HAL 9000, which begins to act against them.

title: Beau Travail
plotSummary: From Marseille, former Foreign Legion sergeant Galoup recalls his time leading a platoon in Djibouti, where he grew jealous of a popular new recruit, Sentain. Loosely based on Melville's Billy Budd, the film follows how his resentment leads him to destroy the young man and himself.

title: Man with a Movie Camera
plotSummary: With no actors, story or intertitles, the film follows a cameraman through a day of Soviet city life, from dawn to dusk, filming people at work, at play and on the streets. It shows its own making, from shooting to editing to screening, and uses double exposures, freeze frames and fast and slow motion to celebrate what cinema can do.

title: Singin' in the Rain
plotSummary: In 1927 Hollywood, silent-screen star Don Lockwood and his co-star Lina Lamont have to make the leap to talking pictures, but Lina's voice is shrill and grating. Don, his friend Cosmo and aspiring actress Kathy Selden save the film by turning it into a musical, with Kathy secretly dubbing Lina's voice.

title: Sunrise: A Song of Two Humans
plotSummary: A farmer, infatuated with a vacationing woman from the city, is persuaded to drown his wife and run away with her. On the boat he cannot go through with it, and the terrified wife flees to the city, where the couple spend a day rediscovering their love. A storm on the journey home puts it to the test.

title: The Rules of the Game
plotSummary: Aviator André Jurieux, in love with the married Christine, is invited to a weekend hunting party at her husband's country château. As the guests pursue affairs upstairs, the servants act out their own downstairs, and a jealous gamekeeper's rage turns a night of farce into tragedy.

title: Cléo from 5 to 7
plotSummary: Cléo, a young Parisian pop singer, spends two hours waiting for the results of a medical test that may show she has cancer. As she wanders the city, visiting a fortune teller, her lover and a friend, she meets a soldier on leave who is about to go to Algeria.

title: The Searchers
plotSummary: In 1868 Texas, Civil War veteran Ethan Edwards returns home just before Comanche raiders massacre his brother's family and carry off his young niece Debbie. With Martin Pawley, an adopted member of the family, he spends years searching for her, but Martin comes to fear that Ethan means to kill her.

title: Meshes of the Afternoon
plotSummary: A young woman returns home, falls asleep in a chair and enters a dream that keeps repeating itself. In a loop of recurring objects, a key, a knife, a flower, and a hooded figure with a mirror for a face, she meets multiple versions of herself in a short experimental film with no dialogue.

title: Close-Up
plotSummary: Hossain Sabzian, an unemployed film buff, convinces a wealthy Tehran family that he is the director Mohsen Makhmalbaf and says he will cast them in his next film, until he is arrested for fraud. Kiarostami filmed the real trial and had the real people re-enact the events, and the film ends with Sabzian meeting the real Makhmalbaf.

title: Persona
plotSummary: Stage actress Elisabet Vogler suddenly stops speaking during a performance of Electra. A young nurse, Alma, is put in charge of her care at a seaside cottage, and as Alma talks endlessly to her silent patient, confiding her secrets, the two women's identities seem to merge.

title: Seven Samurai
plotSummary: In 16th-century Japan, villagers who know bandits will return after the harvest recruit samurai to defend them, offering only food in payment. The veteran Kambei gathers six other masterless warriors, including the wild Kikuchiyo, and they train the farmers and fortify the village for the final battle.

title: Late Spring
plotSummary: Twenty-seven-year-old Noriko lives contentedly with her widowed father, a professor, and has no wish to marry. Worried she will end up alone, he pretends that he intends to remarry, and she reluctantly agrees to an arranged marriage.

title: The Passion of Joan of Arc
plotSummary: Drawn from the records of her trial, the film follows Joan of Arc's final day in English captivity as clerical judges interrogate her, trying to make her renounce her claim that her mission came from God. Worn down by threats of torture, she signs a confession, then recants, and is burned at the stake.

title: Playtime
plotSummary: Monsieur Hulot tries to keep an appointment in a Paris of glass and steel office blocks, while a group of American tourists, among them a young woman named Barbara, see the city only through its modern buildings. Their paths cross through a trade fair and the chaotic opening night of a new restaurant.

title: Do the Right Thing
plotSummary: On the hottest day of the summer in Brooklyn's Bedford-Stuyvesant, pizza delivery man Mookie works for Sal, the Italian-American owner of a pizzeria in the mostly Black neighbourhood. Racial tensions between the residents and Sal's family build through the day and erupt into violence that night.

title: The Night of the Hunter
plotSummary: Harry Powell, a serial killer posing as a preacher, learns from a condemned cellmate that he hid $10,000 and only his two young children know where. Powell marries the man's widow and terrorises the children, who flee down the river and are taken in by the kindly, fierce Rachel Cooper.

title: Au hasard Balthazar
plotSummary: A donkey named Balthazar is christened and loved by Marie, a farmer's daughter, when both are young. Over the years he passes from owner to owner, beaten, worked and briefly cherished, while Marie's life falls apart through her relationship with a cruel local youth.

title: Shoah
plotSummary: In this documentary of more than nine hours, Lanzmann interviews survivors, witnesses and perpetrators of the Holocaust, and visits the sites of the Nazi extermination camps in Poland as they are today. He uses no archive footage, building the film entirely from testimony and the places where the killings happened.

title: Daisies
plotSummary: Two young women, both named Marie, decide that since the world is spoiled, they will be spoiled too. They pull a series of pranks, conning older men into buying them dinners and causing chaos at a nightclub and a banquet, in an anarchic comedy that the Czechoslovak authorities banned.

title: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
plotSummary: In 18th-century Brittany, painter Marianne is commissioned to paint the wedding portrait of Héloïse, a young woman who has just left the convent and refuses to pose. Pretending to be her walking companion, Marianne studies her by day and paints her in secret, and the two women fall in love.

title: Psycho
plotSummary: Phoenix secretary Marion Crane steals $40,000 from her employer and runs away to join her lover, stopping for the night at the remote Bates Motel. The shy motel keeper Norman Bates seems dominated by his invalid mother, and when Marion disappears, her sister and a private investigator come looking for her.

title: Mirror
plotSummary: A dying poet looks back on his life, and the film moves between his childhood memories of the war years in the countryside, his troubled relationship with his ex-wife and son, and Soviet newsreel footage. The same actress plays both his mother and his wife.

title: L'Atalante
plotSummary: Jean, the captain of a river barge, marries country girl Juliette and takes her to live aboard with his gruff old first mate and a crowd of cats. Bored with life on the canals and lured by the bright lights of Paris, Juliette slips ashore, and the heartbroken Jean sails on without her.

title: Pather Panchali
plotSummary: In a village in 1920s Bengal, young Apu grows up in a poor Brahmin family with his older sister Durga, their mother and an ancient aunt. While their father goes to the city in search of work, the family struggles to get by, and Apu discovers the wonders and losses of childhood.

title: M
plotSummary: A child murderer is terrorising Berlin, and the police crackdown is disrupting the city's underworld, so its criminal bosses organise their own manhunt using a network of beggars. A blind balloon seller recognises the killer's whistled tune, the man is marked with a chalked M, and he is captured and put on trial by a mob court.

title: City Lights
plotSummary: The Tramp falls in love with a blind flower seller who mistakes him for a rich man, and befriends an eccentric millionaire who only recognises him when drunk. Determined to pay for an operation to restore the girl's sight, he tries everything from street sweeping to boxing to raise the money, at the cost of his own freedom.

title: Rear Window
plotSummary: Confined to his Greenwich Village apartment with a broken leg, photographer L. B. Jefferies passes the time watching his neighbours through the rear window. When he becomes convinced that a salesman across the courtyard has murdered his wife, he enlists his girlfriend Lisa and his nurse Stella to prove it.

title: Breathless
plotSummary: Michel, a petty crook who models himself on Humphrey Bogart, shoots a policeman after stealing a car and goes to Paris. Hiding out with Patricia, an American student who sells the New York Herald Tribune on the Champs-Élysées, he tries to collect money owed to him and persuade her to run away with him to Italy.

title: Some Like It Hot
plotSummary: Two Chicago musicians who witness the St. Valentine's Day Massacre escape the mob by disguising themselves as women in an all-female band headed to Florida. Joe falls for the band's singer Sugar Kane, while Jerry, as Daphne, attracts the attentions of an eccentric millionaire.

title: Bicycle Thieves
plotSummary: In postwar Rome, Antonio Ricci finally lands a job pasting up posters, which requires a bicycle, and his wife pawns the family's bedsheets to redeem his. On his first day it is stolen, and Antonio and his young son Bruno search the city for the thief, until, in desperation, he is tempted to steal one himself.

title: Stalker
plotSummary: In an unnamed country, a guide known as a Stalker leads two clients, a writer and a professor, into the Zone, a guarded area where the laws of physics seem to have changed. At its centre is said to be a Room that grants a person's deepest wish, and as they make their way towards it, they question what they really want.

title: Killer of Sheep
plotSummary: Stan works long shifts in a slaughterhouse in the Watts district of Los Angeles, and the drudgery leaves him sleepless and numb to his wife's affection. Episodes of daily life in the neighbourhood, children playing in vacant lots and friends trying to buy a car engine, add up to a portrait of the community.

title: Barry Lyndon
plotSummary: In 18th-century Ireland, Redmond Barry flees home after a duel and becomes a soldier, deserter and gambler. Through cunning he marries the wealthy Countess of Lyndon and takes her name, but his social climbing and his feud with her son lead to his downfall.

title: North by Northwest
plotSummary: Mistaken for a government agent, New York advertising executive Roger Thornhill is kidnapped by foreign spies and then framed for a murder at the United Nations. On the run across the country, he is helped by the mysterious Eve Kendall, and the chase ends on Mount Rushmore.

title: Wanda
plotSummary: Wanda, a woman from the Pennsylvania coal country, gives up custody of her children and drifts from place to place with no money and no plan. In a bar she falls in with a small-time crook, Mr. Dennis, and gets dragged into helping him rob a bank.

title: The 400 Blows
plotSummary: Twelve-year-old Antoine Doinel is neglected by his parents and in constant trouble at school in Paris. He starts skipping class, runs away and steals a typewriter from his stepfather's office, which lands him in a reform school near the sea.

title: News from Home
plotSummary: Long, static shots of New York in the mid-1970s, its streets, subway cars and empty buildings, are set to Akerman reading letters her mother sent her from Belgium. The affectionate, worried letters are often drowned out by the city's noise, so the film becomes a portrait both of the city and of the distance between a mother and daughter.

title: Ali: Fear Eats the Soul
plotSummary: Emmi, a lonely widowed cleaning woman in her sixties in Munich, steps into a bar to shelter from the rain and meets Ali, a Moroccan migrant worker some twenty years younger. The two fall in love and marry, but they face the scorn of her children, neighbours and colleagues.

title: Sherlock Jr.
plotSummary: A small-town cinema projectionist who dreams of being a detective is framed by a rival for stealing his sweetheart's father's watch. Dozing off in the projection booth, he walks into the film on screen and becomes the debonair sleuth Sherlock Jr., solving a case of his own amid a string of impossible stunts.

title: Contempt
plotSummary: French screenwriter Paul Javal is hired by a brash American producer to rewrite Fritz Lang's film adaptation of the Odyssey, being shot in Rome and on Capri. When Paul appears to push his wife Camille into the producer's company, her love for him turns to contempt.

title: Battleship Potemkin
plotSummary: In 1905, sailors aboard the Russian battleship Potemkin revolt against their officers after being ordered to eat maggot-ridden meat. When the townspeople of Odessa gather to honour a sailor killed in the mutiny, tsarist troops massacre them on the city's harbour steps, and the fleet is sent to crush the rebel ship.

title: Blade Runner
plotSummary: In Los Angeles in 2019, Rick Deckard, a retired "blade runner", is forced to hunt down four replicants, bioengineered humans, who have escaped from an off-world colony to find their creator and extend their short lifespans. During the hunt he falls for Rachael, a replicant who believes she is human.

title: Sans Soleil
plotSummary: A woman reads letters from a fictional cameraman travelling between Japan, Guinea-Bissau, Iceland and San Francisco, set to images he has filmed. The essay film reflects on memory, time and how images record history, and includes a pilgrimage to the locations of Vertigo.

title: Daughters of the Dust
plotSummary: In 1902, three generations of women of the Peazant family, Gullah people living on the Sea Islands off South Carolina, gather on the eve of the family's migration to the mainland. The night before they leave, they argue over what to keep from their traditions and their African heritage.

title: Goodfellas
plotSummary: Henry Hill grows up idolising the gangsters of his Brooklyn neighbourhood and rises in the Lucchese crime family alongside the volatile Tommy DeVito and the hijacker Jimmy Conway. After decades of crime, a drug habit, paranoia and the threat of being killed lead Henry to become an FBI informant.

title: Touki Bouki
plotSummary: Mory, a cowherd who rides a motorbike with a pair of bull's horns on it, and Anta, a university student, dream of leaving Dakar for a glamorous life in Paris. To pay for the voyage, they try a series of schemes and cons.

title: The Red Shoes
plotSummary: Young dancer Victoria Page joins Boris Lermontov's ballet company and becomes a star in a new ballet, The Red Shoes, scored by composer Julian Craster. When she and Julian fall in love, the possessive Lermontov forces her to choose between her art and her love.

title: Metropolis
plotSummary: In a futuristic city, an elite lives in luxury above ground while workers toil underground running its great machines. Freder, the son of the city's ruler, falls for Maria, a young woman who preaches peace to the workers, and his father has an inventor build a robot in her likeness to incite them to riot.

title: Andrei Rublev
plotSummary: In episodes spanning the early 15th century, the icon painter Andrei Rublev travels through a Russia torn by Tatar raids, famine and the cruelty of princes. After witnessing a massacre he stops painting and takes a vow of silence, until a young bell-maker's bold casting of a great bell restores his faith.

title: La Jetée
plotSummary: After a nuclear war has left Paris uninhabitable, scientists living underground send a prisoner back in time because of a childhood memory he has of a woman's face on the observation pier at Orly airport. Told almost entirely through still photographs, the short film follows his visits to the past and the woman he falls in love with there.

title: L'Avventura
plotSummary: During a yachting trip among the Aeolian Islands, a young woman named Anna disappears on a barren island. Searching for her, her lover Sandro and her best friend Claudia begin an affair, and Anna is gradually forgotten.

title: Journey to Italy
plotSummary: An English couple, Alex and Katherine Joyce, drive to Naples to sell a villa they have inherited. Away from their routine, the coldness in their marriage comes to the surface, and as Katherine tours museums, catacombs and the ruins of Pompeii, they decide to divorce.

title: My Neighbor Totoro
plotSummary: Sisters Satsuki and Mei move with their father to an old house in the countryside of 1950s Japan to be near their mother, who is in hospital. Exploring the woods, they meet Totoro, a giant, friendly forest spirit, who has magical adventures with them and helps when Mei goes missing.

title: Sansho the Bailiff
plotSummary: In medieval Japan, the wife and children of an exiled governor are kidnapped on their way to join him, and his son Zushiō and daughter Anju are sold into slavery on the estate of the cruel bailiff Sansho. Years later, Zushiō escapes and sets out to free the slaves and find his lost mother.

title: Imitation of Life
plotSummary: Widowed aspiring actress Lora Meredith takes in Annie Johnson, a Black single mother, and her light-skinned daughter Sarah Jane, and Annie becomes her housekeeper and friend. As Lora rises to Broadway stardom, Sarah Jane passes as white and rejects her devoted mother.

title: Histoire(s) du cinéma
plotSummary: Made over ten years in eight chapters, the video essay mixes film clips, paintings, photographs, text and music into a personal history of cinema and the 20th century. Godard argues that cinema failed in its duty to bear witness to the Holocaust.

title: A Matter of Life and Death
plotSummary: RAF pilot Peter Carter bails out of his burning bomber without a parachute and should have died, but a heavenly conductor misses him in the fog. Having fallen in love with the American radio operator who heard his last message, Peter must argue his case before a celestial court for the right to stay on Earth.

title: Modern Times
plotSummary: Driven to a breakdown by the relentless pace of a factory assembly line, the Tramp is caught up in the turmoil of the Great Depression, mistakenly jailed as a communist agitator and released into unemployment. He teams up with a spirited orphan girl and the pair try to make a home for themselves.

title: Sunset Boulevard
plotSummary: Struggling screenwriter Joe Gillis, on the run from debt collectors, takes refuge in the decaying mansion of Norma Desmond, a forgotten silent-film star planning her return to the screen. He becomes her kept man and helps with her script, but Norma will not let him go.

title: Céline and Julie Go Boating
originalTitle: Céline et Julie vont en bateau
plotSummary: Julie, a librarian, and Céline, a magician, meet in a Paris park and become playful friends. They find their way into a mysterious suburban house where the same melodrama plays out every day, ending with the poisoning of a little girl, and set out to rescue her.

title: A Brighter Summer Day
plotSummary: In early-1960s Taipei, teenager Xiao Si'r, the son of mainland Chinese immigrants, drifts into the orbit of the city's youth gangs. He falls for Ming, a girlfriend of an exiled gang leader, while his father is persecuted by the authorities, and the story ends in a killing based on a real case.

title: Sátántangó
plotSummary: On a decaying collective farm in Hungary after communism, the remaining villagers plan to run away with the money they have earned, until they hear that Irimiás, a charismatic man believed dead, is returning. In seven and a half hours of long takes, he persuades them to give him their savings and follow him.

title: Blue Velvet
plotSummary: Returning to his idyllic hometown of Lumberton, college student Jeffrey Beaumont finds a severed human ear in a field. Investigating with the detective's daughter, Sandy, he becomes entangled with the troubled nightclub singer Dorothy Vallens and the psychopathic gangster Frank Booth.

title: The Spirit of the Beehive
plotSummary: In a remote Castilian village in 1940, just after the Spanish Civil War, seven-year-old Ana sees Frankenstein at a travelling cinema show. Her older sister tells her the monster is a spirit she can summon, and Ana goes looking for it, finding a wounded Republican soldier hiding in an abandoned barn.

title: Pierrot le Fou
plotSummary: Bored with his bourgeois marriage, Ferdinand runs away from Paris with Marianne, his children's babysitter and a former lover, leaving a dead man in her apartment. Pursued by gangsters, the couple head for the south of France, where their idyll comes apart.

title: The Shining
plotSummary: Writer Jack Torrance takes a job as the winter caretaker of the isolated Overlook Hotel in the Colorado Rockies and moves in with his wife Wendy and son Danny, who has psychic powers. As the snow cuts them off, the hotel's ghosts drive Jack to madness and he turns on his family.

title: Chungking Express
plotSummary: Two stories of lovesick Hong Kong policemen. In the first, a cop dumped by his girlfriend vows to fall for the next woman he meets, a drug smuggler in a blonde wig. In the second, another cop pining for his ex is noticed by Faye, a snack-bar worker who secretly lets herself into his apartment.

title: Ugetsu
plotSummary: In 16th-century Japan, during a civil war, the potter Genjūrō and his brother-in-law Tōbei leave their wives behind to seek their fortunes, one in the market and the other as a samurai. Genjūrō is seduced by the mysterious Lady Wakasa, who turns out to be a ghost, while their wives suffer the cost of their ambition.

title: The Earrings of Madame de...
plotSummary: In Belle Époque Paris, an aristocrat's wife secretly sells a pair of diamond earrings her husband gave her to pay her debts. The earrings change hands again and again, eventually reaching an Italian diplomat with whom she falls passionately in love, and their journey exposes her marriage.

title: Once Upon a Time in the West
plotSummary: Jill McBain arrives in the frontier town of Flagstone to find her new husband and his children murdered by the hired gun Frank, who works for a railroad baron. A mysterious harmonica-playing stranger, with his own reason to want Frank dead, and the outlaw Cheyenne set out to protect her land.

title: A Man Escaped
originalTitle: Un condamné à mort s'est échappé
plotSummary: In 1943, French Resistance fighter Fontaine is imprisoned by the Germans in Lyon and sentenced to death. Using a spoon to slowly loosen the boards of his cell door, he plans his escape in painstaking detail, until a teenage boy is put in his cell and he has to decide whether to trust him.

title: The General
plotSummary: Rejected by the Confederate army at the start of the Civil War, Southern railroad engineer Johnnie Gray is thought a coward by his sweetheart Annabelle. When Union spies steal his beloved locomotive, The General, with Annabelle aboard, he gives chase alone deep into enemy territory and has to steal it back.

title: Black Girl
plotSummary: Diouana, a young Senegalese woman, follows the French couple she worked for in Dakar to their home in Antibes, expecting to look after their children and see France. Instead she is confined to their apartment as a maid and treated with contempt, and her isolation drives her to despair.

title: Get Out
plotSummary: Chris Washington, a young Black photographer, goes to meet his white girlfriend Rose's parents at their secluded estate for the weekend. Their excessive friendliness and the strange behaviour of the Black housekeeper and groundskeeper unsettle him, and he discovers that the family has sinister plans for him.
